Chemistry and Biochemistry


Chemistry and Biochemistry (CHEM )


See Class Sections Below

Policies and Deadlines: https://go.ucsd.edu/4dacX2K Lab Safety Requirements: https://go.ucsd.edu/43MIfZ9 ATTENDANCE AT THE FIRST LAB MEETING IS MANDATORY: Students who miss the first 30 minutes of the first lab meeting of the quarter will be administratively dropped from the course. Come prepared to work by wearing long pants and closed-toe shoes, and bringing your textbook, lab notebook, knee-length lab coat, and goggles. LABORATORY SAFETY REQUIREMENT: All students in CHEM 7L, 7LM, 43A, 100A, 100B, 105A, 108, 109, 123, 143B/C are required to pass the Lab Safety Exam for their course in the current term BY MONDAY OF WEEK 1 AT 8AM. Students who do not pass the Lab Safety Requirement will be administratively dropped from the course. Please check the Canvas Safety Site for each lab class you are enrolled in for specific quarter deadlines. FEES FOR LABORATORY COURSES: Students who enroll in CHEM lab courses are charged a lab fee assessed with registration fees. The fees are: CHEM 7L- $40: CHEM 7LM- $40: CHEM 43A- $75: CHEM 100A- $65: CHEM 100B- $156: CHEM 105A- $65: CHEM 105B- $65: CHEM 108- $175: CHEM 109- $175: CHEM 123- $175: CHEM 143B- $110: CHEM 143C- $155.

7L General Chemistry Laboratory
Lab sections meet starting WEEK 1. Students who miss the first 30 minutes of the first lab meeting of the quarter will be administratively dropped from the course. Students are required to pass the Lab Safety Exam for their course in the current term BY MONDAY OF WEEK 1 AT 9AM. Students who do not pass the Lab Safety Requirement will be administratively dropped from the course. Please check the Canvas Safety Site for each lab class you are enrolled in for specific quarter deadlines. Deadline to ADD or DROP without a 'W' for CHEM LAB courses is by the end of the scheduled second lab meeting. For Summer Session, if you drop after the second lab meeting, you will receive a 'W' and will not be eligible for a tuition refund. Policies and Deadlines: https://go.ucsd.edu/4dacX2K, Lab Safety Requirements: https://go.ucsd.edu/43MIfZ9 Students who enroll in CHEM 7L will be charged a $40.00 lab fee that will be assessed with registration fees.

143B Organic Chemistry Lab II
Lab sections meet starting WEEK 1. Students who miss the first 30 minutes of the first lab meeting of the quarter will be administratively dropped from the course. Students are required to pass the Lab Safety Exam for their course in the current term BY MONDAY OF WEEK 1 AT 9AM. Students who do not pass the Lab Safety Requirement will be administratively dropped from the course. Please check the Canvas Safety Site for each lab class you are enrolled in for specific quarter deadlines. Deadline to ADD or DROP without a 'W' for CHEM LAB courses is by the end of the scheduled second lab meeting. For Summer Session, if you drop after the second lab meeting, you will receive a 'W' and will not be eligible for a tuition refund. Policies and Deadlines: https://go.ucsd.edu/4dacX2K, Lab Safety Requirements: https://go.ucsd.edu/43MIfZ9 Students who enroll in CHEM 143B will be charged a $110.00 lab fee that will be assessed with registration fees.

227 Seminar/Inorganic Chemistry
For Chemistry/Biochemistry graduate students only. Seminars presented by faculty and students on topics of current interest in inorganic chemistry, including areas such as bioinorganic, organometallic and physical-inorganic chemistry. The course is designed to promote a critical evaluation of the available data in specialized areas of inorganic chemistry. Each quarter, three or four different topics will be discussed. Please refer to the department website for specific seminar details: https://chemistry.ucsd.edu/ext/seminars.html.
